failure_condition: The informative image has no text alternative.
interaction_steps: Inspect the image and its accessible representation.
expected_outcome: The defective informative image has no alt attribute; the control has a meaningful alternative. Both variants use alt="" on a decorative image.
manual_verification_method: Inspect image purpose and alternative text with a human reviewer; confirm decorative-image treatment where applicable.
dom_testability: Directly testable for alt-attribute presence; semantic appropriateness requires human review.
accessibility_tree_testability: Testable for computed image role/name; semantic appropriateness requires human review.
limitations: Attribute presence alone cannot prove that alternative text is accurate or useful.
